calculator_engine: function foBrokerage(cv,premium,lot,type){const isFutures=type.includes('Futures');const turnover=isFutures?cv:premium*lot;const brok=Math.min(cv*0.0003,20)*2;const stt=isFutures?cv*0.0002:premium*lot*0.000625;const exchCharge=isFutures?cv*0.00002:premium*lot*0.00053;const gst=(brok+exchCharge)*0.18;const sebi=cv*0.0000001;const total=brok+stt+exchCharge+gst+sebi;return{brokerage:brok,stt,exchCharge,gst,sebi,total,pct:(total/cv*100).toFixed(4)};}
